title: The 6-Metre Strip Cut Along the US-Canada Border #shorts
summary: The International Boundary Commission keeps more than 8,000 monuments and reference points along the 8,891 km boundary and clears a 6 m vista along the land boundary.
tags: why is the us canada border straight
sources: Boundary length 8,891 km (5,525 miles) across North America; over 8,000 monuments and reference points; a 6 metre (20 foot) wide clear vista along the land boundary, 3 m (10 ft) on either side of the line (International Boundary Commission, The Boundary): https://internationalboundarycommission.org/en/about/the-boundary.php

Land boundary 5,061 km identified by a series of straight lines which intersect at boundary monuments; 5,528 boundary monuments; 2,172 km of the land boundary runs through forest where the vista must be cleared on a regular basis; Atlantic to Pacific 6,416 km = 2,878 km land + 3,538 km water (3,538 / 6,416 = 55%); Pacific to Arctic (Alaska) 2,475 km (International Boundary Commission, Did you know?): https://internationalboundarycommission.org/en/the-boundary-and-you/interesting-facts.php

Map data: Natural Earth (public domain) https://www.naturalearthdata.com and US Census Bureau cartographic boundary files (public domain) https://www.census.gov/geographies/mapping-files/time-series/geo/carto-boundary-file.html

scenes.narration: The US-Canada border runs {8,891 km|eight thousand eight hundred and ninety-one kilometres}, Alaska included.
From the Atlantic to the Pacific, more than half of it runs through water.

data.title: Mostly *water*
data.source: Intl. Boundary Commission: 3,538 of 6,416 km in water

scenes.narration: On land, crews look after more than {8,000|eight thousand} markers, and clear a strip {6 m|six metres} wide, even through forest.
